sample.annotation_rules: Ground truth is rule-derived from signals independent of the evaluated model: EXIF capture time (file mtime when EXIF is absent), pixel geometry, exposure/colour statistics over a 384 px RGB thumbnail, InsightFace face count and RapidOCR text presence. grade 2 = strict rule, grade 1 = documented neighbouring band. Thresholds are fixed before any model run and are chosen on the tuning queries only; labels are not human judgements but objective attribute matches, which is the accuracy limit of this evaluation.
